Name: Alternate Clothes for Female Alex
Author: JohnnyGat12345
Description:
This was a modification of Adarin's genderbend series of the bachelors. I wanted to add a little more style to the bachelors, so I edited Sebastian, Alex, and Elliot. This file is Alex's modification.

The rationale was that I wanted Alex to look more like a prep-school type of football player, especially since I think she looked cuter in a school uniform than in the green jacket her original portrait used. I would love to see this portrait and sprite used in your games, so feel free to upload images! Furthermore, if there are any issues with the mod, please let me know.

Next on the list will be Harriet and Sam.
